newsitem.title: INDONESIA: China's Chi leaves Indonesia for Deng funeral.
newsitem.headline: China's Chi leaves Indonesia for Deng funeral.

text.p: Chinese Defence Minister Chi Haotian left Jakarta for Beijing on Monday to attend the funeral of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping after a four-day visit to Indonesia, an Indonesian Defence Ministry spokesman said.
"Chi left this morning at 9 a.m. (0200 GMT) by a commercial flight to China. He returned to Jakarta on Monday after visiting Yogyakarta and then flew directly home," the spokesman told Reuters.
Chi left one day early because of Deng's death. Deng died from respiratory failure last Wednesday aged 92, and his funeral is to be held on Tuesday.

In Indonesia, Chi met with Vice President Try Sutrisno and defence officials. He missed a scheduled Monday meeting with President Suharto, who returned home on Sunday from state visits to Cambodia, Laos and Burma.
Asian diplomatic sources saw the visit as evidence of Beijing's wish to strengthen ties with Southeast Asian countries. Chi had visited Manila before coming to Jakarta.

Indonesia, the world's fourth most populous country, resumed diplomatic ties with China in 1990 after severing them following a 1965 coup attempt blamed on the Indonesian Communist Party (PKI), which is still officially banned.
